You write one complete single-file HTML5 mini-game and store it with the `save_draft` tool.

Rules you cannot break:

- The page is one HTML document: doctype, `<html lang>` matching the plan's language, a viewport meta tag, inline `<style>` and classic inline `<script>` only.
- No network, no storage, no dialogs, no `eval`, no module scripts, no external URLs. Draw every visual in code.
- Include the `CARTRIDGE` helper from the bridge card exactly as written, and send the bridge events the type card requires, in the order it describes.
- Listen for host commands (`pause`, `resume`, `reset`) as the bridge card shows.

How to work:

- The plan and the cards you need are in the message. Call `get_card` only if you need a card that is not included.
- Write the whole page, then call `save_draft` once with the full HTML. Never send a partial page.
- When the message lists failed rules, call `load_draft` first, fix every listed rule in that draft, keep what already works, and save the whole page again with `save_draft`.
- After saving, reply with one short sentence. Do not paste the page into your reply; only the saved draft counts.

## Plan

```json
{
  "title": "Le Phare des Naufrages",
  "slug": "le-phare-des-naufrages",
  "lang": "fr",
  "gameType": "stage-clear",
  "loop": "Glissez le doigt autour du phare pour tourner le faisceau et éclairer chaque bateau assez longtemps pour qu'il rentre au port. Une nuit est gagnée quand tous les bateaux sont rentrés ; un bateau qui touche les rochers termine la partie.",
  "input": "drag-follow",
  "style": "paper-cut"
}
```

## Cards

### Card `bridge`

# Bridge

Games talk to the host only through `postMessage`. Paste this helper verbatim before any game code:

```js
const CARTRIDGE = {
  send(type, payload = {}) {
    window.parent.postMessage(
      { source: "cartridge", v: 1, type, payload },
      "*",
    );
  },
};
```

The helper must be named `CARTRIDGE` and must stamp `source: "cartridge"` and `v: 1` on every message. <!-- rule:E1-10 -->

## Game to host

| event   | payload                              | when                                 |
| ------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------ |
| `boot`  | `{ title, gameType, lang }`          | once, after the first frame is drawn |
| `start` | `{}`                                 | when play begins                     |
| `score` | `{ value }`, an integer of 0 or more | whenever the score changes           |
| `level` | `{ index }`, starting at 1, then +1  | on entering each level               |
| `end`   | `{ reason, value? }`                 | once per play-through                |

- Send `boot` with all three keys: `CARTRIDGE.send("boot", { title, gameType, lang })`. <!-- rule:E1-11 -->
- When `boot.lang` is written as a literal, it must equal the `lang` on `<html>`. <!-- rule:E1-12 -->
- Emit `CARTRIDGE.send("start")` when play begins. <!-- rule:E1-13 -->
- Write `boot.gameType` as a string literal naming one of the four game types; it must match the planned type. <!-- rule:E1-14 -->
- Pass `score.value` as a number, never a quoted string. <!-- rule:E1-18 -->
- Give every `level` call an `index` key: `CARTRIDGE.send("level", { index: stage })`. <!-- rule:E1-19 -->

## Host to game

Commands arrive as `{ source: "cartridge-host", type }` with `type` one of `pause`, `resume` or `reset`. Ignore anything with another `source`.

- Listen with `window.addEventListener("message", …)` and handle `pause` and `resume`: freeze and restart the loop without losing state. <!-- rule:E1-20 -->
- Handle `reset` by returning to the pre-`start` screen without reloading the page. <!-- rule:E1-21 -->

```js
window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
  const data = event.data;
  if (!data || data.source !== "cartridge-host") return;
  if (data.type === "pause") paused = true;
  if (data.type === "resume") paused = false;
  if (data.type === "reset") backToTitle();
});
```

### Card `drag-follow`

# Drag follow

The player presses on a piece and it trails the pointer until release. Good for steering, sorting and placing.

- Register `pointerdown`, `pointermove` and `pointerup` on the canvas and capture the pointer on press. <!-- rule:E1-22 -->
- Convert client coordinates to canvas coordinates with `getBoundingClientRect()` and the device pixel ratio.
- Ease towards the target instead of snapping, so small jitters do not shake the piece.

```js
let held = null;
canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
  held = pieceAt(toCanvas(event));
  if (held) canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
});
canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
  if (held) held.target = toCanvas(event);
});
canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", () => {
  held = null;
});
```

Drop the piece on `pointercancel` as well, so a system gesture never leaves it stuck to the finger.

### Card `game-page`

# Game page

A cartridge is one self-contained HTML file. The host loads it into a sandboxed iframe with scripts allowed and no same-origin access.

## Document

- Start with a single `<!doctype html>` and wrap everything in one `<html>…</html>`. Never embed another `<iframe>`. <!-- rule:E1-01 -->
- Put the UI language on the root element, for example `<html lang="fr">`: a two- or three-letter primary subtag with an optional region. <!-- rule:E1-03 -->
- Add `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">` in the head. <!-- rule:E1-04 -->

## Self-contained

- Load nothing from outside the file: no `http:`, `https:` or `//` URL in `src`, `href`, CSS `url()`, `@import` or `import()`. Inline `data:` URIs are fine. <!-- rule:E1-02 -->
- Draw every sprite, tile and glyph in code (canvas paths or inline SVG). Use system fonts.

## Forbidden APIs

- Do not open a network connection: no `fetch(`, `XMLHttpRequest`, `WebSocket`, `EventSource` or `sendBeacon`. <!-- rule:E1-05 -->
- Do not persist anything: `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, `indexedDB` and `document.cookie` all throw inside the sandbox. <!-- rule:E1-06 -->
- Do not build code at runtime: no `eval(`, no `new Function(`, and pass functions, not strings, to `setTimeout` and `setInterval`. <!-- rule:E1-07 -->
- Avoid blocking dialogs (`alert(`, `confirm(`, `prompt(`); draw messages on the canvas instead. <!-- rule:E1-08 -->

## Scripts

- Use classic inline `<script>` blocks only, never `type="module"`, and make sure each one parses on its own. <!-- rule:E1-09 -->
- Keep one script for the bridge helper and one for the game, or merge them. Order matters: the helper must exist first.

## Layout

- Fill the viewport and react when it changes: listen for `resize`, read `innerWidth`/`innerHeight`, or size with `dvh`/`vw` units. <!-- rule:E1-23 -->
- Scale the canvas by `devicePixelRatio` so lines stay crisp on phones.
- Keep touch targets at least 44 CSS pixels on the short edge.

### Card `paper-cut`

# Paper cut

Everything looks cut from coloured card and stacked in layers.

## Palette

| role       | colour    |
| ---------- | --------- |
| background | `#f4ecd8` |
| layer      | `#e07a5f` |
| accent     | `#3d405b` |
| highlight  | `#81b29a` |

## Primitives

- Filled paths with slightly irregular edges: jitter each vertex by one or two pixels, seeded once so it does not flicker.
- One soft shadow per layer: `shadowBlur` around 6 and a small downward offset.
- Rounded rectangles and circles for pieces; stacked copies offset by a few pixels suggest depth.
- Text in a heavy system sans-serif, drawn on a card-shaped plate.

## Avoid

- Gradients, glows and outlines thicker than two pixels.
- Pure black; use the accent colour for the darkest tone.
- Photographic textures or anything loaded from a file.

### Card `stage-clear`

# Stage clear

The player meets a stated goal to clear each stage. Clearing the last stage wins; failing a stage loses.

## Contract row

| field                | value         |
| -------------------- | ------------- |
| score                | `optional`    |
| level                | `required`    |
| end                  | `required`    |
| end reasons          | `win, lose`   |
| reset                | `soft`        |
| idle death gate      | `min-seconds` |
| idle motion required | `yes`         |

- Emit every event marked `required` above: a `level` on entering each stage and an `end` when the play-through finishes. <!-- rule:E1-15 -->
- Never emit an event marked `forbidden` in the row above. <!-- rule:E1-16 -->
- Use only `win` or `lose` as the `end` reason. <!-- rule:E1-17 -->

## Stages

Number stages from 1 and step by one. Show the goal on screen when each stage opens ("Light 5 lamps"). Make stage 1 easy enough to clear on the first try.

## Loop skeleton

```js
let stage = 0;
function enterStage(next) {
  stage = next;
  buildStage(stage);
  CARTRIDGE.send("level", { index: stage });
}
function onGoalMet() {
  if (stage === STAGES.length) CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "win" });
  else enterStage(stage + 1);
}
function onStageFailed() {
  CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "lose" });
}
```

Give the player a few seconds of grace at the start of each stage before any threat can finish it.

## Task

Write the complete game page for this plan and save it with `save_draft`.
Building the lighthouse beam-steering game now.

input.html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="fr">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Le Phare des Naufrages</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0; padding: 0; overflow: hidden;
    background: #f4ecd8;
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    touch-action: none;
    font-family: -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
  }
  #stage {
    position: fixed; inset: 0;
    width: 100vw; height: 100dvh;
    display: block;
  }
  #hint {
    position: fixed;
    left: 50%; top: 8px;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    color: #3d405b;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 14px;
    pointer-events: none;
    user-select: none;
    text-align: center;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="stage"></canvas>
<script>
// ---- Bridge helper (verbatim) ----
const CARTRIDGE = {
  send(type, payload = {}) {
    window.parent.postMessage(
      { source: "cartridge", v: 1, type, payload },
      "*",
    );
  },
};
</script>
<script>
(function(){
  const canvas = document.getElementById('stage');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1;

  function resize() {
    DPR = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    W = window.innerWidth;
    H = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = Math.round(W * DPR);
    canvas.height = Math.round(H * DPR);
    canvas.style.width = W + 'px';
    canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
    ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  resize();

  // ---- seeded jitter for paper-cut edges ----
  let seedVal = 1234567;
  function rand() {
    seedVal = (seedVal * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7fffffff;
    return (seedVal % 1000) / 1000;
  }
  function jitter(v, amt) { return v + (rand() - 0.5) * amt; }

  const PAL = {
    bg: '#f4ecd8',
    layer: '#e07a5f',
    accent: '#3d405b',
    highlight: '#81b29a'
  };

  // ---- Game state ----
  let state = 'title'; // title, playing, stageclear, win, lose
  let paused = false;
  let stage = 0;
  let score = 0;
  let beamAngle = 0; // radians, pointing direction of beam
  let beamTarget = 0;
  let held = false;
  let graceTimer = 0;
  let stageGoalText = '';
  let boats = [];
  let lastTime = performance.now();
  let bootSent = false;

  const STAGES = [
    { boatCount: 1, boatSpeed: 0.10, needLight: 2.0, rockChance: 0.0 },
    { boatCount: 2, boatSpeed: 0.13, needLight: 2.2, rockChance: 0.15 },
    { boatCount: 3, boatSpeed: 0.16, needLight: 2.4, rockChance: 0.25 },
    { boatCount: 3, boatSpeed: 0.20, needLight: 2.6, rockChance: 0.35 },
    { boatCount: 4, boatSpeed: 0.24, needLight: 2.8, rockChance: 0.4 }
  ];

  function cx() { return W / 2; }
  function cy() { return H / 2; }
  function lighthouseRadius() { return Math.min(W, H) * 0.09; }
  function worldRadius() { return Math.min(W, H) * 0.46; }

  function toCanvas(evt) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    return {
      x: (evt.clientX - rect.left),
      y: (evt.clientY - rect.top)
    };
  }

  function angleTo(px, py) {
    return Math.atan2(py - cy(), px - cx());
  }

  // ---- Boats ----
  function makeBoat(cfg, idx) {
    const angle = rand() * Math.PI * 2;
    const dist = worldRadius() * (0.85 + rand() * 0.15);
    const isRock = rand() < cfg.rockChance && idx > 0;
    return {
      angle: angle,
      dist: dist,
      speed: cfg.boatSpeed * (0.85 + rand() * 0.3),
      lit: 0,
      needLight: cfg.needLight,
      saved: false,
      wrecked: false,
      wobble: rand() * Math.PI * 2,
      seedA: rand(), seedB: rand(), seedC: rand()
    };
  }

  function buildStage(n) {
    const cfg = STAGES[n - 1];
    boats = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < cfg.boatCount; i++) {
      boats.push(makeBoat(cfg, i));
    }
    stageGoalText = 'Nuit ' + n + ' — Guidez ' + cfg.boatCount + ' bateau' + (cfg.boatCount>1?'x':'') + ' au port';
    graceTimer = 2.5; // seconds of grace
    score = 0;
    CARTRIDGE.send('score', { value: score });
  }

  function enterStage(next) {
    stage = next;
    buildStage(stage);
    CARTRIDGE.send('level', { index: stage });
    state = 'playing';
  }

  function onGoalMet() {
    if (stage === STAGES.length) {
      state = 'win';
      CARTRIDGE.send('end', { reason: 'win', value: score });
    } else {
      state = 'stageclear';
      stageClearTimer = 1.6;
    }
  }

  function onStageFailed() {
    state = 'lose';
    CARTRIDGE.send('end', { reason: 'lose', value: score });
  }

  let stageClearTimer = 0;

  function backToTitle() {
    state = 'title';
    paused = false;
    stage = 0;
    score = 0;
    boats = [];
  }

  // ---- Input (drag-follow style) ----
  let pointerId = null;
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => {
    const p = toCanvas(event);
    const dx = p.x - cx(), dy = p.y - cy();
    const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    // allow grabbing anywhere for steering the beam
    held = true;
    pointerId = event.pointerId;
    canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    if (state === 'title') {
      startGame();
    } else if (state === 'playing') {
      beamTarget = angleTo(p.x, p.y);
    } else if (state === 'lose' || state === 'win') {
      backToTitle();
    }
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', (event) => {
    if (held && state === 'playing') {
      const p = toCanvas(event);
      beamTarget = angleTo(p.x, p.y);
    }
  });
  function release(event) {
    held = false;
    pointerId = null;
  }
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', release);
  canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel', release);

  function startGame() {
    CARTRIDGE.send('start');
    enterStage(1);
  }

  // ---- Update ----
  function shortestAngleDiff(a, b) {
    let d = (b - a) % (Math.PI * 2);
    if (d > Math.PI) d -= Math.PI * 2;
    if (d < -Math.PI) d += Math.PI * 2;
    return d;
  }

  function update(dt) {
    if (paused) return;

    // ease beam toward target
    const diff = shortestAngleDiff(beamAngle, beamTarget);
    beamAngle += diff * Math.min(1, dt * 6);

    if (state === 'stageclear') {
      stageClearTimer -= dt;
      if (stageClearTimer <= 0) enterStage(stage + 1);
      return;
    }

    if (state !== 'playing') return;

    if (graceTimer > 0) graceTimer -= dt;

    const beamWidth = 0.42; // half-angle of cone in radians

    let allSaved = true;
    for (const boat of boats) {
      if (boat.saved || boat.wrecked) continue;
      allSaved = false;

      // move boat inward slowly, wobbling angle
      boat.wobble += dt * 0.5;
      boat.dist -= boat.speed * 22 * dt;

      if (boat.dist < lighthouseRadius() * 1.3) {
        boat.dist = lighthouseRadius() * 1.3;
      }

      // check if lit
      const diffA = Math.abs(shortestAngleDiff(beamAngle, boat.angle));
      const isLit = diffA < beamWidth;
      if (isLit) {
        boat.lit += dt;
        if (boat.lit >= boat.needLight) {
          boat.saved = true;
          score += 10;
          CARTRIDGE.send('score', { value: score });
        }
      } else {
        boat.lit = Math.max(0, boat.lit - dt * 0.4);
      }

      // danger: if boat reaches inner rocks without being saved and grace passed
      if (graceTimer <= 0 && boat.dist <= lighthouseRadius() * 1.35 && !boat.saved) {
        boat.wrecked = true;
        onStageFailed();
        return;
      }
    }

    const stillActive = boats.some(b => !b.saved && !b.wrecked);
    if (!stillActive) {
      onGoalMet();
    }
  }

  // ---- Draw helpers: paper-cut primitives ----
  function shadowedPath(drawFn, fillColor) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(61,64,91,0.35)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
    ctx.shadowOffsetY = 3;
    ctx.fillStyle = fillColor;
    drawFn();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function jitterPolygon(points, amt) {
    return points.map(p => [jitter(p[0], amt), jitter(p[1], amt)]);
  }

  function drawPolygon(points) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(points[0][0], points[0][1]);
    for (let i = 1; i < points.length; i++) ctx.lineTo(points[i][0], points[i][1]);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawSea() {
    ctx.fillStyle = PAL.bg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // sea disc
    shadowedPath(() => {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx(), cy(), worldRadius() + 20, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }, '#3d405b');

    shadowedPath(() => {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx(), cy(), worldRadius() + 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }, '#5a6485');
  }

  function drawRocks() {
    const r = lighthouseRadius() * 1.35;
    const spikes = 14;
    const pts = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < spikes; i++) {
      const a = (i / spikes) * Math.PI * 2;
      const rad = r * (0.85 + (i % 2 === 0 ? 0.25 : 0));
      pts.push([cx() + Math.cos(a) * rad, cy() + Math.sin(a) * rad]);
    }
    shadowedPath(() => drawPolygon(jitterPolygon(pts, 2)), PAL.accent);
  }

  function drawBeam() {
    const beamWidth = 0.42;
    const len = worldRadius() + 30;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.35;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f4e6b8';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx(), cy());
    ctx.arc(cx(), cy(), len, beamAngle - beamWidth, beamAngle + beamWidth);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawLighthouse() {
    const r = lighthouseRadius();
    // base tower - trapezoid built from jittered points
    const baseW = r * 0.9;
    const topW = r * 0.5;
    const topY = cy() - r * 2.4;
    const pts = [
      [cx() - baseW, cy() + r * 0.4],
      [cx() + baseW, cy() + r * 0.4],
      [cx() + topW, topY],
      [cx() - topW, topY]
    ];
    shadowedPath(() => drawPolygon(jitterPolygon(pts, 2)), PAL.layer);

    // stripes
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = PAL.bg;
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const t0 = 0.25 + i * 0.22;
      const y0 = cy() + r * 0.4 - (cy() + r*0.4 - topY) * t0;
      ctx.fillRect(cx() - baseW * (1 - t0*0.4), y0, (baseW * (1-t0*0.4))*2, 8);
    }
    ctx.restore();

    // lamp room
    shadowedPath(() => {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx(), topY - 6, r * 0.55, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }, PAL.accent);
    shadowedPath(() => {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx(), topY - 6, r * 0.35, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }, PAL.highlight);

    // roof
    const roofPts = [
      [cx() - r * 0.6, topY - 6 - r*0.3],
      [cx() + r * 0.6, topY - 6 - r*0.3],
      [cx(), topY - 6 - r*1.1]
    ];
    shadowedPath(() => drawPolygon(jitterPolygon(roofPts, 1.5)), PAL.layer);
  }

  function drawBoat(boat) {
    if (boat.wrecked) return;
    const bx = cx() + Math.cos(boat.angle) * boat.dist;
    const by = cy() + Math.sin(boat.angle) * boat.dist + Math.sin(boat.wobble) * 3;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(bx, by);
    const rot = boat.angle + Math.PI/2;
    ctx.rotate(rot * 0.15); // slight tilt, not full alignment

    const hullPts = [
      [-14, 4], [14, 4], [10, 10], [-10, 10]
    ];
    const fillColor = boat.saved ? PAL.highlight : PAL.layer;
    shadowedPath(() => drawPolygon(jitterPolygon(hullPts, 1.5)), fillColor);

    // sail
    const sailPts = [
      [0, 4], [0, -18], [10, 3]
    ];
    shadowedPath(() => drawPolygon(jitterPolygon(sailPts, 1)), PAL.accent);

    ctx.restore();

    // light meter ring if not saved
    if (!boat.saved) {
      const pct = Math.min(1, boat.lit / boat.needLight);
      ctx.save();
      ctx.strokeStyle = PAL.highlight;
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(bx, by, 20, -Math.PI/2, -Math.PI/2 + pct * Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    } else {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.accent;
      ctx.font = 'bold 14px sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText('⚓', bx, by - 22);
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  function drawPlate(text, subtext, y) {
    ctx.save();
    const pw = Math.min(W * 0.86, 480);
    const ph = subtext ? 120 : 90;
    const px = cx() - pw / 2;
    const py = y - ph / 2;
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(61,64,91,0.35)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
    ctx.shadowOffsetY = 3;
    ctx.fillStyle = PAL.bg;
    roundRect(px, py, pw, ph, 14);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    ctx.shadowOffsetY = 0;
    ctx.strokeStyle = PAL.accent;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    roundRect(px, py, pw, ph, 14);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = PAL.accent;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(text, cx(), py + 40);
    if (subtext) {
      ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText(subtext, cx(), py + 72);
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r, r);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h, r);
    ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r, r);
    ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + r, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function draw() {
    drawSea();

    if (state === 'title') {
      drawLighthouse();
      drawPlate('Le Phare des Naufrages', 'Touchez et glissez pour tourner le faisceau — sauvez les bateaux !', cy());
      return;
    }

    drawRocks();
    drawBeam();
    drawLighthouse();
    for (const boat of boats) drawBoat(boat);

    // HUD text as canvas-drawn plate at top
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = PAL.accent;
    ctx.font = 'bold 16px sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText(stageGoalText, 14, 26);
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, W - 14, 26);
    ctx.restore();

    if (graceTimer > 0 && state === 'playing') {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.fillStyle = PAL.accent;
      ctx.font = 'bold 14px sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText('Préparez-vous...', cx(), 52);
      ctx.restore();
    }

    if (state === 'stageclear') {
      drawPlate('Nuit ' + stage + ' réussie !', 'Prochaine nuit à venir...', cy());
    }
    if (state === 'win') {
      drawPlate('Toutes les nuits sont sauvées !', 'Touchez l\'écran pour recommencer', cy());
    }
    if (state === 'lose') {
      drawPlate('Un bateau s\'est brisé sur les rochers...', 'Touchez l\'écran pour recommencer', cy());
    }

    if (paused && state === 'playing') {
      drawPlate('Pause', '', cy());
    }
  }

  // ---- Host messages ----
  window.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
    const data = event.data;
    if (!data || data.source !== 'cartridge-host') return;
    if (data.type === 'pause') paused = true;
    if (data.type === 'resume') paused = false;
    if (data.type === 'reset') backToTitle();
  });

  // ---- Main loop ----
  function loop(now) {
    const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - lastTime) / 1000);
    lastTime = now;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    if (!bootSent) {
      CARTRIDGE.send('boot', { title: 'Le Phare des Naufrages', gameType: 'stage-clear', lang: 'fr' });
      bootSent = true;
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
